dashboard.shortcut_tkdl_desc: Separate public prior-art pointers from restricted TKDL access.
dashboard.shortcut_navigator_desc: Surface evidence relevant to patents, GI, trade marks, designs and copyright.

profile.title: Profile & preferences
profile.description: Manage your workspace identity and the jurisdiction used as the default research context.
profile.jurisdiction_desc: This preference is used when creating new research cases.
profile.security_desc: API requests include the current bearer token. In production, prefer a server-managed HTTP-only cookie for session storage.
profile.preferences_saved_desc: Your default research jurisdiction has been updated.

case_new.title: Case title
case_new.title_placeholder: e.g. Ashwagandha extract for stress-management claims
case_new.first_schedule_label: Does it appear in a First-Schedule authoritative text?
case_new.jurisdiction_desc: This case-level setting is sent to the backend so the evidence set remains jurisdiction-specific.
case_new.select_ip_type_err: Select at least one IP type
case_new.select_ip_type_desc: Choose the protection regimes you want Sahayak to evaluate.
case_new.create_success_desc: Your research brief is ready for fact verification.
case_new.create_error: We couldn't create the research case
case_new.create_error_desc: Please review the case details and try again.
case_new.novelty_placeholder: Describe the technical, formulation, process or commercial features you believe are new.
case_new.novelty_hint: Focus on the feature you believe is genuinely new, not the traditional ingredients or uses you inherited.
case_new.traditional_placeholder: Describe traditional ingredients, formulations, uses, source texts or community-held knowledge involved.
case_new.traditional_hint: Be explicit about known Ayurvedic texts, customary use or traditional formulation features.
case_new.ip_types_hint: Only selected regimes are sent as the navigator's retrieval scope.
case_new.ingredients_hint: Add each ingredient separately and cite the source text you are relying on for that ingredient.
case_new.first_schedule_q: Does it appear in a First-Schedule authoritative text?
case_new.processing_placeholder: Describe heating, extraction, purification, fermentation, dosage preparation or other manufacturing steps.
case_new.intended_use_placeholder: State the intended use and the exact therapeutic, wellness or other claims to be assessed.
case_new.modifications_placeholder: Describe any change to ingredients, proportions, dosage, processing or presentation compared with the classical formulation.
case_new.bio_resources_hint: List each biological resource separately so access and source facts remain checkable.
case_new.origin_title: Source / origin location (State, District, Forest, Farm)
case_new.origin_placeholder: e.g. Uttar Pradesh, India — district / region if known
case_new.origin_hint: Use the access location or provenance you know; geography can affect the backend ABS assessment.
case_new.community_desc_placeholder: Describe the community or traditional-knowledge holder involvement, known consent/process context, or relevant knowledge contribution.
case_new.tkdl_formulation_placeholder: Describe the formulation, plant parts, processing method or claimed novelty...
case_new.tkdl_source_title: Authoritative source text or oral-tradition reference (if known)
case_new.tkdl_source_placeholder: e.g. classical text, chapter/verse, practitioner record, community reference or oral-tradition note.
case_new.tkdl_novel_title: What do you believe may be novel?
case_new.tkdl_novel_placeholder: Be specific about the feature, method, combination or use you want the prior-art search to scope.
case_new.tkdl_novel_hint: This scopes retrieval; it is not a frontend determination of novelty.
case_new.product_form_hint: Product form helps scope the backend route before claim and labelling checks.
case_new.reg_use_placeholder: What is the product intended to do or support?
case_new.reg_claims_placeholder: Enter the claims exactly or as closely as possible.
case_new.reg_dosage_placeholder: Dosage, frequency, route and directions for use.

compare.title: Jurisdiction Diff
compare.description: Side-by-side structured comparison of Indian statutory bars vs. international novelty standards.
compare.query_placeholder: e.g. Herbal formulation containing Ashwagandha and Turmeric
compare.formulation_placeholder: Describe the formulation, ingredients, processing and intended use.
compare.not_legal_advice: This is an AI-assisted information system, not legal advice.
compare.ai_unavailable: AI explanation unavailable; showing evidence-based comparison.
compare.intl_note: International comparison provides a general international framework. Actual patentability and legal requirements depend on the target country/region.
compare.error: The comparison could not be completed. Please try again.
compare.empty_input: Enter a query or formulation to compare.

reasoning.title: Deep Research
reasoning.description: Add one or more aspects of the same problem. The assistant classifies each formulation, traverses the knowledge graph, retrieves TKDL evidence and composes a citation-grounded answer — then compares them on a coverage radar.
reasoning.aspects_hint: Add different questions/formulations for the same product (e.g. patentability, ABS, regulatory) — each becomes a coloured series on the radar.
reasoning.coverage_hint: Relevance of each project dimension per aspect (0–1), scored deterministically from the knowledge graph and retrieved evidence.
reasoning.query_placeholder: e.g. Is my classical Ayurvedic churna patentable, and what about TKDL and ABS?
reasoning.formulation_placeholder: Ingredients, processing, intended use — helps classify the product.
reasoning.abstained: The assistant abstained: insufficient authoritative evidence for a safe answer.
reasoning.ai_unavailable: AI explanation unavailable; showing deterministic, evidence-based reasoning.
reasoning.no_citations: No citations were gathered for this query.
reasoning.error: The analysis could not be completed. Please try again.

connectors.title: Connected Sources
connectors.description: Connect your own paid legal/IP database with an API key. Your credential stays on this server, is masked, and is used only with your explicit, logged consent.
connectors.name: Display name
connectors.consent_label: I authorize IP-SAKTI to store this credential on this server and use it on my behalf. Every use is recorded in the audit log below.
connectors.fill_required: Please fill name, base URL and API key.
connectors.need_consent: Please tick the authorization box to continue.
connectors.privacy_note: Keys are stored locally on the backend and never shown in full. You can disable or remove a source at any time. All actions are logged for accountability, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection regime.
connectors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
connectors.key_placeholder: paste your key — stored locally, masked

archive.title: Case archive
archive.description: Browse, filter and reopen past evidence-grounded research cases. This view is designed for retrieval, not dashboard monitoring.
archive.reopen_hint: Click a row to reopen the case
archive.no_records_desc: Adjust your filters or clear the search.
archive.export_empty: No cases match the current filters.

sources.title: Source library
sources.description: Browse the source categories the research service can use to ground an assessment. Each category exposes a versioned catalog surface; restricted databases remain access-controlled.
sources.freshness_desc: Last synchronized: 27 Aug 2026 · Backend sync status: demonstration data. Production deployments should expose the authoritative sync timestamp from the corpus service.
sources.paid_desc: Connect a user-provided subscription only after explicit consent is recorded.
sources.catalog_note: Source records shown here are a frontend catalog surface. The backend must remain the authority for current versions, access permissions, citations and actual retrieval results.
sources.detail_note: Current source text, version metadata and citation validity must be supplied by the backend corpus service before being treated as authoritative.
sources.cat_indian_ip_desc: Patents, geographical indications, trade marks, designs and copyright sources.
sources.cat_bio_desc: Biological-diversity legislation, rules and access-and-benefit-sharing material.
sources.cat_tk_desc: Public traditional-knowledge references and restricted TKDL access pointers.
sources.cat_ayush_desc: Drug, advertising, food and cosmetic classification material relevant to Ayurvedic products.
sources.cat_intl_desc: TRIPS, CBD, Nagoya, WIPO GRATK, PCT and related international systems.
sources.cat_prior_desc: Patent and public-registry records returned by the evidence layer.

tools.ask_desc: Ask anything about Ayurvedic IP, TK or regulatory status — Sahayak answers from cited sources only.
tools.ask_prompt: e.g. Can a modified Ayurvedic formulation be protected by a patent in India?
tools.ask_sidebar_1: Retrieved statute, rule or treaty passages
tools.ask_sidebar_4: Escalation path when evidence is insufficient
tools.navigator_title: Map the right IP protection path
tools.navigator_desc: Separate what is genuinely novel from what comes from traditional knowledge, then scope the IP regimes worth evaluating.
tools.navigator_prompt: Summarize the product, how it is made, and the business context.
tools.navigator_sidebar_3: GI, trade mark, design and copyright applicability
tools.classifier_desc: Classify the formulation using checkable ingredient, source-text, processing, claims and modification facts. The backend determines the supported regulatory category and evidence requirements.
tools.classifier_prompt: Add any context that does not fit the structured classification fields above...
tools.classifier_sidebar_2: Degree of modification from the classical formula
tools.abs_title: Prepare a biodiversity / ABS research case
tools.abs_desc: Capture biological resources, source location, access context and intended commercial use so the backend can assess the relevant ABS pathway.
tools.abs_prompt: Describe the biological resource, where it was accessed, its source/community context and intended use...
tools.tkdl_title: Investigate traditional knowledge and prior art
tools.tkdl_desc: Surface TKDL and public prior-art signals relevant to a patentability or novelty question. This tool returns source candidates rather than a patentability verdict.
tools.tkdl_prompt: Add any context about the technique, traditional use or search scope...
tools.regulatory_desc: Capture product form, intended use, label claims, dosage and marketing channel so the backend can map the applicable drug, advertising or food/cosmetic route.
tools.regulatory_prompt: Add any product facts that do not fit the structured regulatory fields above...
tools.regulatory_sidebar_1: Which Act governs: Drugs & Cosmetics / Magic Remedies / FSSAI

case_view.desc_ask: A grounded answer with supporting citations and an assessment-confidence indicator.
case_view.desc_default: Backend analysis is the source of truth. This screen only presents returned classification, evidence, confidence and next actions.
case_view.ready_answer_desc: Sahayak will retrieve supporting evidence, validate citations and return an assessment-confidence indicator.
case_view.facts_ready_desc: Run the backend analysis to retrieve the classification, applicable rule, evidence and confidence breakdown.
case_view.reg_pipeline_desc: The classification below is the backend assessment for the structured ingredient, source-text, processing, claims and modification facts you supplied.
case_view.insufficient_evidence_desc: The available evidence is not sufficient to support a reliable assessment.
case_view.no_next_action: Analysis has not yet returned a next action.
case_view.review_requested_desc: The case has been queued for human review.
case_view.access_posture_desc: Public TKDL information may be shown when returned by the backend. Restricted TKDL entry content is not displayed by this prototype.
case_view.default_next_action: Review the candidate records and follow up through the appropriate source registry or human facilitator.
case_view.route_matrix_desc: Each row reflects a backend assessment for an IP regime selected during intake.
case_view.no_obligations: No obligation items were returned by the backend.
case_view.intl_disclosure_desc: This section appears only for international cases. The backend must determine whether a cross-border Nagoya Protocol or WIPO GRATK disclosure requirement actually applies.
case_view.no_intl_disclosure: No international disclosure obligation was returned.
case_view.prior_art_desc: These are source candidates returned by the backend. They are not a legal novelty or patentability determination.
case_view.no_candidates: No prior-art candidates were returned for this search scope.
case_view.no_route_items: No route items were returned by the backend.

verify.desc_abs: Confirm the resource, geography, access, community/TK and intended-use facts before the ABS pathway assessment.
verify.desc_tkdl: Confirm the search description, source reference and novelty focus before prior-art retrieval.
verify.desc_default: Confirm the structured facts before analysis. Extraction and normalization are shown separately from user corrections.
verify.banner_abs: No final ABS pathway or obligation assessment is displayed until the access facts are confirmed.
verify.banner_tkdl: No prior-art candidates are displayed until the search scope facts are confirmed.
verify.banner_default: No final legal or regulatory assessment is displayed until facts are confirmed.
verify.facts_updated_desc: The verified facts are ready for analysis.

explain.title: Explainability
explain.description: A traceable view of the backend workflow from facts through rules, evidence, citation validation and confidence.
explain.versioning_desc: Older analysis versions remain distinct. The backend should supply changed facts, changed rules and confidence delta when versions are compared.
explain.error_trace: We couldn't load the analysis trace.
explain.error_trace_desc: Please return to the result and try again.

report.title: Case report
report.description: A printable, shareable view of the current evidence-grounded assessment. The report is informational and remains subject to backend evidence and versioning.
report.report_contents_desc: The generated backend report may contain classification, confidence, rules, evidence, citations, limitations, ABS/TKDL indicators and other case-specific research outputs.
report.readonly_sharing_desc: This prototype copies the current case URL. A tokenized public link can be enabled later if the backend adds one.

history.title: Case history
history.description: Review the audit trail of this research case, including when facts changed, who made the change, and when analyses were run.
history.history_desc: A chronological record of case creation, fact changes, confirmation, analysis and other backend-reported actions.
history.no_history: No case history is available for this record.
history.error_history: We couldn't load the case history.
history.error_history_desc: Please try again from the case report.
